name: Alfoz de Quintanadueñas (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over green with a yellow cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alfoz de Quintanadueñas (a tower and a wheel on red and green).
history: Municipal flag of Alfoz de Quintanadueñas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alfoz de Quintanadueñas arms — tower and wheel
